correlationId.description: Exact request value on success and failure; null if absent in a malformed request. UUID format is not enforced.

requestIdentity.description: Exact request object, including extra properties, on success and failure; null if absent in a malformed request.

entries.description: Filtered page, timestamp descending then id ascending (ordinal string comparison). Offset paging is deterministic for an unchanged ledger; new entries can shift offsets.

total.description: All entries in the selected scope matching startAt/endAt, before paging.

balance.description: Authoritative full-scope balance = sum(put.amount) - sum(take.amount), before date filters or paging. Any stored credits snapshot loses to the ledger.
